name: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731
summary: Run an open-weight (MIT) coding and agent model for pennies — about $0.14 per million input tokens, $0.28 output. This re-tuned build beats the bigger V4-Pro preview on agentic tasks. Grab the weights on Hugging Face or hit the API.

name: Seedance 2.5
summary: Generate a full 30-second video in one shot at up to 4K — no stitching clips together. Feed it up to 50 reference images, and fix a single frame without re-rolling the whole thing. Available via API and partner apps.

name: Kimi K3
summary: Download the open weights of this 2.8T multimodal coding model, now live under a modified-MIT license (a 594GB pull). Or just use it via Kimi.com, Kimi Code, or the API, with a 1M-token context window.

name: Claude Opus 5
summary: Get near-Fable-5 quality at half the price, now the default on Claude Pro and Max. A low/medium/high effort toggle lets you dial cost against capability per task, with sharper autonomous coding. Live in the API today.

name: FLUX 3
summary: Generate video with native synced audio, edit images, and render readable text from one multimodal model. Video is in early access at bfl.ai now, with image generation and downloadable open weights coming. Already powering Photoshop and Picsart features.

name: Laguna S 2.1
summary: Download a free, open-weight coding model that punches above rivals 10x its size on SWE-Bench. It's a 118B mixture-of-experts activating just 8B per token, with a 1M-token context. Grab it on Hugging Face or run it via OpenRouter.

name: Gemini 3.6 Flash
summary: Code and run agents on a cheaper workhorse model — $1.50 per million input tokens, output priced well under the old Flash tier, and 17% fewer output tokens per job. Live in the API and GitHub Copilot now.

name: Buzz
summary: Run a free, open-source team chat that treats AI agents as real members with their own identity and permissions. Includes code hosting and automations, and plugs into Claude Code, Codex, or goose. Mac, Windows, Linux.
